product.title: Everglades Airboat Tour from Fort Lauderdale with transportation
product.description: Go for an immersive airboat ride through Everglades National Park—and leave transit and logistics to someone else—on this half-day tour from Fort Lauderdale. Choose a morning or afternoon departure, ride out to the wetlands, then cruise the waterways while looking for alligators and other native wildlife.
highlights: Ride an airboat through Everglades waterways with a guide
Round-trip transportation from selected Fort Lauderdale pickup points
Watch for alligators, birds, and other local wildlife
Choose a morning or afternoon departure window
inclusions: Hotel pickup and drop-off (selected hotels only)

meetingPoint.description: You can head directly to your preferred meeting point, or request pickup. Selected Hotels only. Please call Alligator Tours for exactly time. Morning pickups 7:45 am to 8:15 am and afternoon pickups 12:00 to 12:30 pm.

faqs.question: Can I be picked up for this tour?
faqs.answer: Yes. Selected Fort Lauderdale hotels and pickup points are available; contact the operator in advance for exact timing.

faqs.question: How long is the tour?
faqs.answer: The experience lasts about 4 hours including transportation and the airboat activity.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking
This tour/activity will have a maximum of 20 travelers
